item.title: Delhi High Court: State Gratuity Authorities lack inherent jurisdiction when establishment has branches in multiple States
item.description: “The fundamental error permeating both the impugned orders is the assumption that merely because the claimant worked or claimed to have worked in Delhi, the Controlling Authority appointed by the State Government and the Appellate Authority derived jurisdiction to adjudicate the dispute.” The post Delhi High Court: State Gratuity Authorities lack inherent jurisdiction when establishment has branches in multiple States appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: 8th ICC India Conference on International Arbitration 2026 in New Delhi
item.description: The 8th ICC India Conference on International Arbitration will be held in New Delhi on 28 February 2026, convening global arbitration experts and ICC Court representatives for a day of discussions on India’s evolving arbitral landscape. An ICC Institute Advanced Training on Interim Measures will precede the conference on 27 February 2026. The post 8th ICC India Conference on International Arbitration 2026 in New Delhi appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: “Highly disciplined, respected organization like RSS maligned”: Allahabad HC quashes criminal case filed by RSS member resident against RWA
item.description: “Prima-facie, a highly disciplined and respected cultural organization like the RSS has been maligned and the membership has been misused in the present case by the informant.” The post “Highly disciplined, respected organization like RSS maligned”: Allahabad HC quashes criminal case filed by RSS member resident against RWA appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Disability pension arrears can’t be restricted to three years once broad banding entitlement stands judicially settled: Supreme Court
item.description: Disability pension is a vested and recurring right, partaking the character of property under Article 300-A, and once found due, must be granted from the date it became payable. The post Disability pension arrears can’t be restricted to three years once broad banding entitlement stands judicially settled: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.
